main116Disposition.change: Discover public releases when GitHub REST API is unavailable.
main116Disposition.equivalentPath: The candidate public signed-release adapter fetches its configured HTTPS channel and artifacts directly. It does not query GitHub REST or use personal account credentials. Fetches are bounded, redirect-denying and signature verified. The legacy GitHub fallback therefore does not need to be copied into this protocol path.
